rule: Memory is the fixture: a folder of dated lessons whose Agreement declares keeps_time: true. Its older files have no id and stay ordinary Notes, outside the timeline and never a diagnostic. A new lesson is an entry; a changed lesson is a correction that supersedes it; what was known as of a date is the as_of selection; what is new since the last session is the since selection. Each is one call.

vectors.rule: Only the boolean true turns time on: that reading is a MUST. Reporting invalid_keeps_time for any other declared value is a MAY in schema/time.md; the reference implementation reports it, and an implementation that claims the report must match these cases. An implementation that does not report it still reads every case as keeps: false.
